safety_contract: Pull requests receive only contents:read permission.
Pages can publish only by workflow_dispatch after an exact 40-character main SHA and PUBLICAR confirmation.
The public artifact is generated from the committed canonical release without a live Notion read.
The canonical release is hashed before and after validation and must remain byte-identical.
The complete public browser suite runs locally before deploy and again against GitHub Pages after deploy.
No workflow in this scope writes to Notion or closes editorial traceability.
